results.title: Scientists propose nuking solution to Doomsday asteroid — as thousands of city-killers swarm Earth - New York Post
results.description: Scientists propose nuking solution to Doomsday asteroid — as thousands of city-killers swarm Earth New York Post Chinese rocket scientists have modelled the most effective way to nuke a doomsday asteroid, and it is not a blast at the surface: first drill a hole, then bury the bomb about thirty metres down, which their simulations say more than triples the deflection Space Daily The real Armageddon? Scientists plan to blow up asteroids with nuclear bombs to save Earth The Independent Scientists discover most effective way to destroy doomsday asteroid The Independent Chinese rocket scientists find ‘most effective’ way to nuke a doomsday asteroid South China Morning Post
